entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm glad we found the entertainment hall,[n]but the president we seek was nowhere[n]to be seen.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I doubt that's the only casino on this ship[n]either. We just have to hope he shows up[n]to ours...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We don't have much of a choice but to[n]try it, right? Let's do this, guys!
